style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent precision car-accessory upgrade visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless pure white #FFFFFF, deep midnight-blue #101A2E, brushed silver #C9CED6 and one accent red #C8102E; cool neutral studio lighting with a soft front-left key, crisp rim highlights along polished metal edges and soft grounded contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif type, one family across the set; consistent rounded-rectangle info labels and thin-line icons in a single accent color; high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero angle with consistent product scale and centering; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand emblems or vehicle logos.
noDrift: no brand emblems or vehicle logos
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle, product centered with consistent scale and a soft contact shadow, no rotation or scale drift between shots; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
style.surfaceSystem: smooth matte white board #FFFFFF, brushed-silver #C9CED6 accents and fine-grain dark leather-texture panel #14161A
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif type, one family across the whole set; headlines in deep midnight-blue #101A2E on light panels and #FFFFFF on dark panels, with accent red #C8102E reserved for short emphasis labels
